description: Use this first when a user names an Australian holiday park, caravan park, or campground and you need the authoritative Total Parks public property ref. Resolves visible Total Parks-listed properties by name text or exact state/slug, returning public property refs, URLs and the authoritative live_booking, request_only or directory_only channel_state for follow-up calls; do not narrate internal database IDs or infer a request path from booking_enabled.

limit.description: Maximum number of property matches to return. Default 5. Example: 3.

query.description: Park name or natural-language lookup text when you do not yet have a public property_ref. Example: 'BIG4 Aireys Inlet'.

slug.description: Exact Total Parks property slug. Pair with state when you already know the listing. Example: 'big4-aireys-inlet'.

state.description: Australian state or territory code or name used with slug for an exact lookup. Example: 'vic' or 'Victoria'.

name: tp_resolve_property

address.description: Public park address for traveller-facing disambiguation.

channel_state.description: Server-authoritative public booking channel. This is separate from search candidate tier.

property_ref.description: Public property reference accepted by MCP tools. Use this, or property_url, for follow-up MCP calls.

property_url.description: Traveller-facing Total Parks URL for the property.

title: Find a Total Parks property
